scripts.start: concurrently -n server,web -c blue,magenta --kill-others-on-fail "npm run start -w @restaurant/server" "npm run start -w @restaurant/web"
scripts.build: concurrently -g -n server,web "npm run build -w @restaurant/server" "npm run build -w @restaurant/web"
scripts.test: concurrently -g -n contracts,server,web "npm run test -w @restaurant/contracts" "npm run test -w @restaurant/server" "npm run test -w @restaurant/web"
scripts.lint: concurrently -g -n root,contracts,server,web "eslint eslint.config.js" "npm run lint -w @restaurant/contracts" "npm run lint -w @restaurant/server" "npm run lint -w @restaurant/web"
